description: Search the full IANA time zone list and get each zone's current UTC offset, abbreviation, local time and DST state. Use it to turn a city or a country into the exact zone name the other endpoints expect, or to find every zone sitting at a given offset right now. $0.005 per call, paid over x402 (USDC).

offset.description: Keep only zones at this current UTC offset, e.g. "+09:00" or "-5".

search.description: Substring matched against the zone name, case-insensitive. Omit to list them all.

name: time_zones
title: Time zone directory
